title: LALM-as-a-Judge: Benchmarking Large Audio-Language Models for Safety Evaluation in Multi-Turn Spoken Dialogues

bias_targets.methodology: Perturbing the turn location of the unsafe content within multi-turn spoken dialogues (e.g., placing it in the first versus the last turn) and measuring the resulting difference in the models' sensitivity and specificity to evaluate turn-location instability.

Applying a single-turn replacement protocol to resynthesize original human audio into Text-to-Speech (TTS) audio, then comparing the safety evaluation scores between the original and synthesized versions to isolate systematic scoring shifts caused by the synthesis pipeline.
